title: CHROMA RIFT — 最後の退館者
composition: Original Goal014 composition; no borrowed melody, MIDI or musical loops.

render.reverb: offline short asymmetric tapped room; no phase-sensitive runtime stems

title_theme.form: A: solo call / A2: cello answer / B: displaced harmony / A3: thinning return

exploration.form: Five rooms: statement / plucked answer / high fragment / open fifth / tonic rest

suspicion.form: Four three-beat phrases: question / semitone shadow / metal echo / withdrawal

pursuit.form: Four compressed cells with off-beat metal; two-beat releases keep footsteps legible

release.form: A short answered call, open fifth and long air after the cadence

chapter_end.form: Unanswered title / widening daylight / D-major answer / decaying final chord / silence
